integrity: The proof classifies zero forcing sets by whether the common center is initially blue and by the occupancy of each outer pair. An independent exhaustive checker simulates the color-change rule on every subset through k=8 and compares every polynomial coefficient.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to friendship graphs under the standard zero forcing rule.
Finite exhaustive verification through k=8 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude an unindexed or differently phrased exact friendship-graph formula.
title: Zero forcing polynomial of friendship graphs
